picker.title: Choose a folder
picker.homeHint: Home directory of the desktop account
picker.drivesHint: Pick a drive to start browsing
picker.manualHint: Hidden folders (names starting with ".", e.g. ~/.config/xxx) are never listed — type the path to reach them.
picker.emptyHint: You can still use this folder; hidden folders (starting with ".") are not listed, so type the path instead.
picker.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} entries only — type a path to reach the rest.
picker.driveHint: Pick a drive first: the drive list itself cannot be a working folder.

manual.title: Type a path
manual.label: Absolute folder path
manual.hint: "~" is supported. The desktop checks the folder exists first, then its canonical path is used.

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.label: Folder name
newFolder.hint: One level only, no "/" or "\". You will be taken into the new folder.

risky.warning: The agent will treat this folder as its main workspace and can read and write inside it — a specific project folder is safer.
risky.whitespace: A path segment starts or ends with a space; the desktop rejects such working folders. Pick another one.

errors.notFound: That path does not exist or cannot be opened — check the spelling
errors.notDirectory: That is not a folder, or the path cannot be resolved
errors.outsideSandbox: That path is outside what the desktop allows browsing
errors.ownerRequired: This account cannot browse desktop files — sign in as the installation owner
errors.authExpired: Your session expired — reconnect to the desktop
errors.csrf: Security check failed — reconnect to the desktop and try again
errors.network: Lost the connection to your desktop — make sure it is still running
errors.nameEdgeWhitespace: The name cannot start or end with a space
errors.invalidName: A folder name must be a single component, without "/" or "\"
errors.parentNotFound: The parent folder does not exist or cannot be opened
errors.parentRequired: Open a folder first, then create one inside it
errors.createDenied: The desktop has no permission to create a folder here
